residual_expansion.granularity: Generate child IDs Mxx.01/Mxx.02 or Ixx.01 from exact remaining classifier/feature/method/rule/initializer clusters. Root normalizes cross-lane requirements before scheduling.
queue_fields: native symbol and exact source/artifact hash
assigned parent record and ordered dependencies
owned write paths and existing lease conflicts
matched native fixture and actual caller
residual_expansion.stop_condition: Do not call this lane complete until every local schema classifier plus every effective inherited external feature, handwritten getter/service method, initializer branch and validation rule has an assigned accepted disposition, and every accepted native user/API corpus passes the Rust application.
residual_expansion.discovery_trigger: A newly discovered native class, feature, override, provider, mutation side effect, proxy/encoding, implicit specialization or rule adds an explicit child record and blocks the affected completeness row; existing counts do not hide it.
residual_expansion.call_closure_scc_policy: M01 condenses mutually recursive native operation/helper closures into explicit implementation slices. Freeze trait/module contracts first; do not qualify one side using fabricated observations or introduce a dependency cycle hidden behind this seed graph. Split scaffolding, bounded SCC implementation and callers before exceeding the review budget.

bounded_direct_symbol_policy.ceilings: At most four direct same-class features or two direct same-class operations; exact native methods and Ecore flags attached. Effective helper/inherited call closure can force further child expansion.
bounded_direct_symbol_policy.acceptance_dependency_semantics: Source deps form the acyclic build order; acceptance_children must all qualify before the umbrella family is accepted, with C03 composing dependency-closed children.

cross_lane_requirements: C01 pins inherited Sirius/EMF/serializer/model service artifacts and startup/provider configuration; source182+4 counts alone do not capture that closure.
C02 owns real native fixture capture, isolated synthetic runtime, failure retention and equivalent workload performance/UX measurements.
Parser lane supplies complete grammar/AST/transform/link/evaluation families for M31/M37/I08; unresolved parser support is never treated as valid model data.
UI/representation U lane consumes typed Rust services, live names/diagnostics/library pickers and custom-node schemas; standalone APIs do not count as integrated user parity.
Transport/persistence lane supplies actor/project/read-only policy, resource I/O capabilities, atomic store/history/subscription adapters and ordered migration execution.
C03 lands prerequisite drafts into integration, retargets children and runs full actual-caller release acceptance.
